meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: MUST USE when asked to find, read, list, search, inspect, fetch, export, or reconstruct coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode, Senpi/pi, oh-my-pi (omp), gajae-code (gjc), OpenClaw, Factory Droid, Amp, Gemini/Kimi/Qwen CLIs, Codebuff, Roo/Kilo/Cline, Kodu, Cursor CLI, Aider, or unknown local agent logs. Covers transcripts, session IDs, rollout JSONL, state SQLite, Claude projects/pre-compact histories, OpenCode messages/parts, child/subagent linkage, cwd/model/time/token filters, archives, and cost clues. Expands fuzzy recall into parallel query lanes and first probes known stores so absent platforms are skipped cheaply. Triggers: coding agent sessions, Codex/Claude/OpenCode/Senpi/pi/oh-my-pi/omp/gajae-code/gjc/OpenClaw/Droid/Amp/Kodu/Cursor/Aider sessions, transcript search, session history, session ID, read transcript, token usage, subagent sessions, what did I do yesterday, did we already do this.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查找并回顾编码助手的历史会话与记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常使用编码助手，需要快速查找或复盘之前的会话记录。
copy.tagline_en: Find and review coding assistant session history and transcripts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use coding assistants and need to quickly search or review previous sessions.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，当你问起之前用编程助手做过什么，Claude 会先搜索本地存储的 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等工具的会话记录，找到相关对话、会话ID、token用量等信息，避免凭空回答。
howto.when: 当你要求查找、阅读、列出、搜索或检查编程工具（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等）的会话时触发，比如问“我昨天做了什么”或“之前那个Bug会话”。

say.text: 帮我找找上周关于数据库重构的 Codex 会话。
say.note: Claude 会搜索本地 Codex 会话并返回匹配结果。

say.text: 搜索所有包含‘token usage’的 Claude 会话。
say.note: Claude 会列出相关会话及其token使用详情。

say.text: 列出昨天用 OpenCode 做的所有会话。
say.note: Claude 会显示昨天的 OpenCode 会话列表。

howto.what_en: When you ask about past work done with coding agents, Claude searches local session logs from Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, etc., finding transcripts, session IDs, token usage, and more before answering from memory.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to find, read, list, search, or inspect coding-agent sessions from platforms like Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, etc., e.g., 'what did I do yesterday' or 'that session about the bug'.

say_en.text: Find my Codex sessions from last week about database refactoring.
say_en.note: Claude searches local Codex sessions and returns matches.

say_en.text: Search all Claude sessions containing 'token usage'.
say_en.note: Claude lists relevant sessions with token details.

say_en.text: List all OpenCode sessions from yesterday.
say_en.note: Claude shows yesterday's OpenCode session list.
